question: Why is Maheśvara called Maheśvara?
premises: Maheśvara resembles beings from dog onward.
inference: Maheśvara is named from resemblance and delight.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic relation to prior verses is unclear.
The gloss of ramyatva as delight is approximate.
plain_english: Maheśvara is so called because of his similarity to beings from the dog onward and because of delight.
